entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Support.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I need to return something. I bought the new VeloBand Cadence Sensor and... I just don't like it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and email address to pull up your account?
Of course. It's Jeanine Poulos. The email is J-Poulos@email.com.
Thank you, Jeanine. I see your account now. Looks like you're one of our VIP members. We really appreciate your loyalty over the years.
I have been, yes. That's why I'm so disappointed with this band. I was so excited for it.
I'm sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken or anything, it's just... so hard to use. The menu system is really confusing. I've read the user manual twice, but I still can't get it to do what I want. I really expected more from a VeloFit product.
I understand the frustration when a new device isn't intuitive. I see you received it on December 15th, so about 29 days ago. Let me just pull up our return guidelines for you.

Oh, I hope it's not too late. I just... I saved up for this, and I feel so guilty that it's just sitting here. I really need that money back if possible. I've always had such good experiences with VeloFit before this.

Please don't worry, Jeanine. Let me check... Okay, I'm looking at our internal knowledge base right now. It shows that all our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that window.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! So I can send it back for a full refund?

Absolutely. I can process that return for you right now. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to your email on file. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your card.
Wow, thank you so much, Alex. You have no idea what a help that is.
It's my pleasure. And as a thank you for your patience and for being such a loyal VIP customer, I've also added a $25 VeloFit credit to your account for any future purchase.
That's so kind of you! You've really turned this around for me. Thank you.
You are very welcome, Jeanine. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
Have a wonderful day, and we hope to see you again soon.
